saints.name: St. John Damascene
saints.title: Priest and Doctor of the Church
saints.shortBlurb: A monk of the Judean desert whose defense of holy images and vast synthesis of the faith earned him the title Doctor of the Church…
biography: John was born about 675 into a Christian family of Damascus and served, as his father had, in the administration of the Muslim caliph before leaving all to become a monk at the laura of Mar Saba near Jerusalem. From there, beyond the reach of the emperor, he wrote his great defense of the veneration of sacred images against the iconoclasts.

His masterwork, The Fount of Knowledge, gathered and ordered the teaching of the Greek Fathers and became a foundation of later theology in both East and West. He died about 749 and was declared a Doctor of the Church in 1890.
saints.knownFor: Defending sacred images and summing up the theology of the Greek Fathers.

canonization.canonized: Venerated from antiquity; declared Doctor of the Church in 1890 by Pope Leo XIII

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 4 December
